theory.request_unit: one request = one VOQ; each source holds N-1 VOQs for unicast alltoall (48×47=2256 on 8×6); aggregate=False
theory.unit: LDPS (link-disjoint path set) replaces the permutation matrix of a crossbar
theory.round_lb: max_e (#VOQs whose XY path uses directed link e) — the Birkhoff permutation-count analog
theory.accept_rule: a VOQ accepts only on UNANIMOUS grants from every link on its route (a crossbar needs 1)
theory.t_sched: dependent arbitration steps x cycles/step, added back onto the DES makespan
theory.area_calibration: state bits + comparators, normalized so greedy_ff = ARB_AREA['ca'] = 0.05
